_verdict.reading: The style dial is not cosmetic. Full style (old broken state: masked embeddings suppress the rhythmic prior) scores 51/C with 26% silence; zero-style pure prior scores 100/S with the strongest beat clarity (0.476) and cleanest signal (0.6% whine) — beating the official JAX reference on rhythm. Half-style + zero 6-11 (track_01, 90/A, beat 0.448) is the sweet spot for style+rhythm balance.
